comments.author: Pinnacle
comments.body: What is the special condition to be fulfilled if you want to can Canned Roasted Chicken with Garlic and onwards, recipes? I have the required Storage and Management Ranks, but can only see the 1st 2 recipes, Canned Curry & Rice and Canned Seafood Pizza. TIA!

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: YOUR nations Industrial port (Portsmouth if English, Bilbao if Spanish, etc) must be in Booming status for this recipe to appear. You can check by going to any major port that has a Business Mediator and clicking on Nation Status with him.
